_comment: FORMAT DOCUMENTATION ONLY -- this file is never scored.
iter_must_find skips every '*.example.json': the phrases below are invented placeholders,
and a must-find phrase is only ever a string a human copied out of a real document
(docs/design/open-inputs.md section 3; design D11). Copy this file to
fixtures/evals/<your-set>.json, replace every placeholder with something you actually
read in the document, and put the document in fixtures/real/.

real/the-document-you-labelled.docx.source: where the document came from, and why it may be used

must_find.term: a phrase you copied verbatim out of the document
must_find.note: where in the document it is, so a reader can find it without the labels

expected_extra.term: a hit the must-find phrases do not account for, but which is real text
expected_extra.note: true_positive: legitimate text the term list also matched

expected_extra.term: a hit that is a different inflection of a must-find phrase
a hit you judge to be a real precision bug
expected_extra.note: false_positive: the term list matched something it should not have
